title: DesignDay Bangalore — Human Machine Interaction
description:
The theme for this month's DesignDay is:

Human Machine Interaction for Consumer Products

It is not uncommon when you talk about design, it is assumed that you are designing for either websites, or mobile apps these days. But we usually ignore a galore of products out there we interact with every day. In our living room, in our kitchen, in your car, and many more places. Have you wondered how these are made? Are they designed in a similar fashion as a website or a mobile app? Or is there more than what meets the eye?

-----

The agenda includes:
1. Design Story: By an experienced designer to walk us through the trials and tribulations of a career in Design.

2. A Case Study/Skill Building Session: By an experienced Designer to teach us something new.

3. A JAM: You will be given a topic and would have to come up with some design suggestions based on that topic in 2 hours. This is a group activity, where participants are split into groups of 4-5 people. We will have markers, sketch pens and chart papers for your use.

Cheers,

Team DesignDay
